name: full-all-diis-from-cg
rationale: The FULL_ALL/CG/0.05 recovery reached SCF convergence at4.3e-7 and E=-225.24748391001486Ha, but MPI finalization then aborted with a leaking-communicator assertion and exit1. Do not accept that execution. Preserve its exact final WFN and start one separate DIIS/FULL_ALL/0.05 execution with the same frozen binary, model and physical inputs. FULL_ALL/DIIS finished cleanly for the other AE molecular references; this tests whether the converged state transfers without the CG path and finalization failure. It is not an unchanged repetition from the earlier unconverged DIIS seed. Accept only if the new execution itself converges, ends without a later abort and passes complete provenance checks. Do not rebuild or suppress MPI error checking.
